brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Three linked cells (piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) joined with double connectors and fitted with two keyhole hangers on rear face (accessory:0#-1,0#2 and accessory:0#1,0#2) – hooks align for wall screws, front visible when mounted.

Three hook plates (hex-acc-hook) on front face at slots 5 on each cell: accessory:0#-1,0#5, accessory:0#0,0#5, accessory:0#1,0#5 – each plate provides two hooks for hanging pliers, screwdrivers, tape measures, etc. Hook plates verified in build and view.

finish.summary: Built 3-cell horizontal rack with rear keyhole hangers for wall mounting and three front hook plates (6 hooks) for hand tools. Structure locked with double connectors, end caps fitted. Hook accessories provide tool hanging function; configurator limits hanging props to gaffer tape/cable coils for demonstration, but hook geometry itself is correct for small hand tools.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
